cw_sr_p4_pause = {

}

clr_country_flag = cw_sr_p4_deployed

}
}

cw_sr_p4_upkeep = {

}
}

divide_temp_variable = { cw_sr_due = 1000 }
set_temp_variable = { cw_sr_whole_m = cw_sr_due }
multiply_temp_variable = { cw_sr_whole_m = 1000 }
subtract_from_variable = { cw_sr_p4_accrued_m = cw_sr_whole_m }
add_to_temp_variable = { cw_sr_due = cw_sr_p4_arrears }
set_temp_variable = { cw_sr_payment = treasury }
clamp_temp_variable = { var = cw_sr_payment min = 0 max = cw_sr_due }

set_variable = { cw_sr_p4_arrears = cw_sr_due }
subtract_from_variable = { cw_sr_p4_arrears = cw_sr_payment }
}
}

cw_sr_p28_upkeep = {
if = { limit = { OR = { has_country_flag = cw_sr_p28_deployed check_variable = { cw_sr_p28_arrears > 0 } } }
set_temp_variable = { cw_sr_accrual = 0 }

set_temp_variable = { cw_sr_accrual = 207.69231 }
if = { limit = { has_country_flag = cw_sr_leader }
multiply_temp_variable = { cw_sr_accrual = 0.95 }
}
}
add_to_variable = { cw_sr_p28_accrued_m = cw_sr_accrual }
set_temp_variable = { cw_sr_due = cw_sr_p28_accrued_m }
divide_temp_variable = { cw_sr_due = 1000 }
set_temp_variable = { cw_sr_whole_m = cw_sr_due }
multiply_temp_variable = { cw_sr_whole_m = 1000 }
subtract_from_variable = { cw_sr_p28_accrued_m = cw_sr_whole_m }
add_to_temp_variable = { cw_sr_due = cw_sr_p28_arrears }
set_temp_variable = { cw_sr_payment = treasury }
clamp_temp_variable = { var = cw_sr_payment min = 0 max = cw_sr_due }
set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = cw_sr_payment }
multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
modify_treasury_effect = yes
add_to_variable = { cw_sr_spent = cw_sr_payment }
set_variable = { cw_sr_p28_arrears = cw_sr_due }
subtract_from_variable = { cw_sr_p28_arrears = cw_sr_payment }
}
}

}
else = {
cw_sr_p35_failure = yes
}
}

}
}

}

}

set_temp_variable = { cw_sr_accrual = 0 }

multiply_temp_variable = { cw_sr_accrual = 0.95 }
}
}

set_temp_variable = { cw_sr_due = cw_sr_p44_accrued_m }
divide_temp_variable = { cw_sr_due = 1000 }
set_temp_variable = { cw_sr_whole_m = cw_sr_due }
multiply_temp_variable = { cw_sr_whole_m = 1000 }
subtract_from_variable = { cw_sr_p44_accrued_m = cw_sr_whole_m }

set_temp_variable = { cw_sr_payment = treasury }

subtract_from_variable = { cw_sr_p44_arrears = cw_sr_payment }
}

cw_sr_p47_pause = {
if = { limit = { is_ai = no IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes has_country_flag = cw_sr_initialized OR = { check_variable = { cw_sr_p47_state = 1 } AND = { has_country_flag = cw_sr_p47_deployed NOT = { check_variable = { cw_sr_p47_state = 4 } } } } }

}

}
}

subtract_from_variable = { cw_sr_p51_arrears = cw_sr_payment }
}

}
}

}
}

}
